payload.title: Router: post all lab jobs first, then collect (and a short collector task)
payload.description: Step 1 of route each story as soon as the lab answers. Cyclotron epic decision-flywheel-c8c8cac6-fc12-422b-9d2b-b6210675b81c. Router.sweep posts every candidate job without waiting, collects during the remaining run time, and a collect task on a short schedule delivers finished jobs.
